name: water-cycle
title: A short lesson: the water cycle

brief.lede: A short classroom example. Follow three steps in the water cycle.
approach: Show one step at a time.

lines: The sun warms water, and some water evaporates into the air.
As the air cools, water vapor forms tiny drops. These drops form clouds.
When the drops grow large enough, rain falls to the ground. The cycle continues.
